clue.text: Attractive ribbon put to sound use

definitions.text: Attractive ribbon put to sound use

parts.words: Attractive ribbon put to sound use
parts.note: an attracting (magnetised) strip of ribbon that is used for recording sound

explanation.surface: A pretty ribbon has been found a sensible purpose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attractive' reads as pretty and 'sound use' as a sensible use; really the ribbon attracts like a magnet and the use is recording sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Recording tape is a long magnetised strip used to store audio.

clue.text: Country doctor, a fabulous old bird, joining the company

parts.note: MO is a Medical Officer, a doctor
the roc is a giant bird of Arabian legend
CO is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A rural doctor and a legendary bird join forces with a firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country doctor' looks like one phrase, but 'Country' is the definition and 'doctor' starts the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Morocco is a kingdom in north-west Africa, a nation.

clue.text: Making points in class can have a devastating effect

definitions.note: a phrase describing a thing; the answer is a noun for such a thing

indicators.note: the points are placed inside the word meaning class

parts.note: a grade is a class or rank

explanation.surface: Scoring points in a lesson can have a big impact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making points in class' suggests a pupil arguing well; 'Making' is a link and the points are E and N.

clue.text: Judges may find a'time's set

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophes adding no letters
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: The nine letters of A TIME'S SET rearrange into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To judge something is to assess or appraise it roughly, a verb sense.

clue.text: One's allowed to see this little place

parts.note: one is I, and one's is I'S, here IS

explanation.surface: A single visitor is permitted to view this small spot.
explanation.definitionFit: An islet is a very small island, a little place in the sea.

clue.text: Worry about raising golden blossom

indicators.note: the word meaning worry goes round the other piece

parts.note: to tease is to worry or pester

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Concern about growing a golden bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Worry' looks like a verb in the surface; it supplies the outer word. In a down clue 'raising' reads the heraldic gold upwards, and 'about' wraps the worry round it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea rose is a garden rose with a scent like tea, a flowering plant.

clue.text: A worker falling in a heap on thereof

explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes where the answer is found: a curved roof tile.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantile is a curved roofing tile laid in overlapping rows.

clue.text: Speed check

clue.text: Intent on Eastern development

explanation.walkthrough: 'sovereign' suggests a king or queen; here it is the old one-pound gold coin, so L, as in £.

clue.text: The recording is not right nor is it great

explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link; the letters of NOR IS IT GREAT rearrange into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A registration is the act of recording something officially, as in an entry in a register.

clue.text: Shout, but no longer make demands

parts.note: ex means former, no longer so

explanation.surface: Shout, but stop insisting on things.
explanation.definitionFit: To exclaim is to cry out suddenly.

clue.text: The sound of traffic in a metropolitan area?

definitions.meaning: horns going is the noise made by cars

explanation.walkthrough: TOOTING is a district of south London, so it is an area of the metropolis.
explanation.definitionFit: Car horns hooting make a toot; separately, a London suburb carries this name.

clue.text: To call up about a woman is all right

indicators.note: the woman's name goes around the other piece

explanation.surface: Ringing about a woman is acceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke is to summon up a memory or feeling.

clue.text: Awful scare lest solution can't be found

clue.text: Painstaking preparation

explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link joining the pieces A, P and PLIER.
explanation.definitionFit: One who applies something puts it on, as with paint.

clue.text: The rifle range

parts.note: read not as a place for target shooting but as the distance a gun's shot reaches

clue.text: Music man given spot by royal characters

ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the royal cipher

clue.text: Making many a turn round catch will generate a current

definitions.note: a verb phrase describing a device; the answer is a noun
